definitions.explanation: A museum with hands-on exhibits about science and technology, often aimed at letting visitors learn through experiments and displays.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We went to the science museum.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a robot exhibit at the science museum.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}って→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦{学|まな}べる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: At the science museum, exhibits you can actually touch and learn from are popular.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧ (science) + ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (hall, building). A facility, often public, with interactive exhibits on science and technology; the suffix ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ appears in many building names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {科学館|かがくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: visit a science museum
- {科学館|かがくかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧: a science museum exhibit
- プラネタリウム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{科学館|かがくかん}: a science museum with a planetarium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧: museum — broader, covering history and nature; a {科学館|かがくかん} focuses on science with hands-on displays
